evidence.evidence_text: We introduce HiQA, a practical hierarchical contextual augmentation framework for multi-document question answering (MDQA).
We introduce HiQA, a practical hierarchical contextual augmentation framework for multi-document question answering (MDQA).
HiQA enriches text chunks with cascading document metadata, such as document titles and section paths, so that retrieval can use both local content and document structure.

Experiments show that HiQA improves retrieval and answer quality on MasQA and remains competitive on public MDQA benchmarks, while its benefits are strongest for structured, domain-specific, highly similar document collections.
